name: generated-game-validation
goal: Generated game checks reject invalid checkpoint graphs and missing view references

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated game projects must enforce the same graph contract as authoring: missing prerequisites, duplicate IDs, cycles and missing transition views fail their ordinary test entrypoint.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing 2D and 3D CLI creation flow verified only valid saved data. Extend the same generated-project checks with invalid-graph fixtures and require validation diagnostics.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 0d0cc2336, the strengthened standard CLI matrix fails because invalid graphs return success from the generated test entrypoint.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Ship the engine validator, validate before gameplay, and include document-contract coverage in each generated project standard unit entrypoint.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
